app.name: Energy flow
app.summary: Solar, grid, battery, home and loads with animated flow dots, like power-flow-card-plus.
app.in_grid_hint: Power in W. Which sign means feed-in is set in the tile's options.
app.in_storage2_hint: Power in W of the extra storage or load drawn at the bottom right.
app.opt_max_power_hint: At this power (and above) the dots run at full speed.
app.opt_invert_grid_hint: On when your grid sensor shows a positive value while you feed in (invert_state in power-flow-card-plus).
app.opt_invert_battery_hint: On when your battery sensor shows a positive value while it charges (invert_state in power-flow-card-plus).
app.opt_invert_storage2_hint: Off: a positive value means the Speicher2 takes power from the house.
app.opt_fps_hint: The dots step at most 4 times a second, because the screen offers its plugins a beat every 250 ms. Fewer steps are easier on the screen.
app.opt_dots_hint: How many dots run along each line (1 to 6). More dots cost screen memory and speed.
app.opt_home_calc_hint: On: Home = solar + grid draw + battery discharge - Speicher2 (Speicher2 counts as consumption while charging). Includes the wallbox. The home sensor is then not used.
app.in_inverter_hint: Shown above the symbol in the PV circle (power in W).
app.opt_label_hint: Up to 64 characters. Empty: the standard name.
app.opt_label_battery_hint: Up to 64 characters. Empty: the standard name. {soc} is replaced by the charge level, e.g. "Battery {soc}" gives "Battery 8 %" and follows the charge level.
